recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Adding more definitions back to managing.html would reintroduce the overlap that FHIR-16466 resolved; adjacent Resource identity issues should be audited separately if selected.
issue_request: FHIR-16466 was Published with a Persuasive STU3 resolution asking for clearer, consistently defined identity terms across logical id, canonical URL, resource identity, identifier elements, literal identity, and full URL. The approved resolution directed the identity text into resource.html#id, made managing.html informative, and had managing.html refer to the normative Resource page.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 14335, preserved as git commit 6952564a0194f2d05079049d21b581cf35342188. That commit moved identity content from source/managing.html into source/resource/resource-notes.xml, removed Consistent Resource Identification from managing.html, changed Managing Resource Identity from normative to informative, and added documentation navigation for the page.
additional_context: Later identity-history work refined the same area without reversing the FHIR-16466 move. Commit 7ee661f6b4022414f36a63274872d7ef207a8716 expanded Resource-page identity terminology for FHIR-17105, FHIR-15615, and FHIR-14191. FHIR-18476 later broadened managing.html from URL-only to URI plus REST URL wording, FHIR-33978 removed intrinsic URL wording from the Resource introduction, and the combined branch already contains audits for those later issues plus a FHIR-14854 source fix for stale links created by the FHIR-16466 relocation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current Resource page source defines Resource Identity, Logical ID, Identifier Categories, Business Identifiers, Canonical URLs, and Consistent Resource Identification, while Managing Resource Identity is informative and points to the normative resource.html#id documentation.
